prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: standalone website photograph illustrating ground surface, geology, and measurement/capture categories. It is a generic environment illustration, not an inspection result.
Primary request: a convincingly realistic photograph of a typical Chinese open-pit quarry or small open-cast mine in clear natural daylight. The main subjects are several terraced cut slopes, pale earthy exposed soil, gravel and crushed stone, and visible natural surface texture. Show a modest stepped quarry face and the adjoining bare ground in a believable everyday industrial landscape, with some green vegetation near the outer edge. No dramatic scenery or disaster.
Composition/framing: wide horizontal photograph, approximately 3:2 and around 1520 by 1035 pixels. Gently elevated oblique view from about 30 meters above the nearby ground, looking toward the terraced slopes and enough foreground surface to understand their shape and texture. Natural camera perspective, no extreme fisheye or schematic top-down orthophoto. Simple, readable composition for use as a small website thumbnail.
Style/lighting: professional documentary landscape photography; bright ordinary daylight, realistic earth and rock textures, restrained gray-brown and natural green colors, plausible sunlight and shadows. Crisp but not oversharpened. No illustration, glossy CGI or artificial geometric terrain.
Constraints: no drone in the frame, no worker close-up, no endangered people, no accident, landslide, collapse, explosions or disaster imagery. No claims or symbols of slope safety, mining compliance, hazard confirmation or measured geometry. No detection boxes, contour overlays, survey markers added as graphics, UI, diagrams, labels, text, readable signs, logos or watermarks.
limitations: AI-generated generic quarry ground-and-geology illustration, not an on-site customer case, verified slope safety assessment, measured survey result, confirmed hazard or model output. The prompted viewpoint of about 30 meters is a compositional reference, not a measured height. Parent owns visual review and website crop verification.
